claim_limits: Source route vertices and substation horizontal coordinates are retained, but GIS lines do not establish electrical connectivity, current, load or direction of flow.
Only source line 3596 has physical line geometry. Its source vertices plus interpolated spans define estimated tower positions, not surveyed tower locations.

Lattice towers, six conductors, one guard wire, tower height, wire radius and parabolic sag are adjustable visual estimates; they are not confirmed circuit configuration or engineering clearance calculations.

Substation tanks, radiators, bushings, gantries, cabinets, footprints and orientations are generic estimated equipment, not measured layouts. Source converter/distribution classifications remain unchanged.
Copernicus is an EGM2008 surface model including vegetation and buildings; terrain is a partial crop sampled every two native pixels, not a bare-earth or local survey.
Landcover classes drive synthetic surface colours; no aerial or reference photograph pixels are copied. Sea level is zero EGM2008 and no bathymetry is claimed.
Overview route widths and vertical offsets are display styling, not measured conductor diameter, underground depth or surveyed altitude. Full mainland HVDC endpoints remain present.
No connection to Tamra wind turbines is inferred. Repeated source IDs are grouped only when type, voltage and full forward/reversed geometry match exactly.

Three PV examples use distinct source registration/geocoded coordinates nearest Hallim; multiple records sharing each coordinate are disclosed. These are not surveyed parcels or confirmed facility footprints.

Each PV example has 4 by 8 ground-mounted demonstration panels with estimated tilt, supports and inverter. Panel count is independent of source capacity; actual panel count, installation type, orientation and footprint remain unknown. Source status is a dated record, not live telemetry; solar_power is null.
